description: Everything usable from the Wikipedia articles on United Kingdom general elections in Ireland and Northern Ireland: party-level results, constituency-level results where given, MPs elected, dates and the sources each article cites. Thirteen category entries are REDIRECTS to the UK-wide article rather than Ireland-specific articles -- all of them pre-1885 -- and are recorded as such, because that absence is itself the finding: the earliest elections have no Wikipedia counterpart to check Walker against. Wikipedia is tertiary; this detects disagreement rather than establishing truth.
